title: ASI Audit Decision
description: Schema for sparse audit notes written by BatchAuditor or CrossBatchAuditor workflows. Absence of an audit decision means no audit objection for normal downstream use.

decisionId.description: Stable ID for this audit decision. Suggested form: audit:<batch-slug>:<decision-kind>:<normalizedKey>.

scope.description: Scope in which the decision applies.

oneOf.description: Decision applies within one ASI batch.
Decision compares or reconciles items across multiple ASI batches.
Decision applies to one canonical document or its extracted items as a group.
Decision applies to one or more specific extracted items.

decision.description: Sparse audit decision for the target extracted item or item set. Audit decisions do not mutate extracted items; later stages derive behavior from these records.

oneOf.description: Reject because it is too generic, incidental, unsupported, or not useful for ASI routing.
Reject because another extracted item or card already covers the same intended meaning.
Same literal key or nearby concept must be split into separate context-specific meanings.
Item should be merged with an existing item or card rather than indexed separately.
Item identifies possible source ambiguity or missing source wording that may need supervisor review.
Item should be reviewed by TerminologyInferrer for possible source term, alias, boundary phrase, relation name, or source heading.
Auditor cannot safely decide; Supervisor or user decision is required before affected downstream use.
Decision intentionally postponed without accepting or rejecting the item.

literalKey.description: Optional literal term/key when the decision concerns same-spelling or same-key items.

normalizedKey.description: Optional normalized key used for matching.

indexerInstruction.description: Instruction to the Indexer, such as create term literal plus term context cards.

sourcePatchRecommendation.description: Whether this audit decision suggests later source-patch consideration. This is not patch approval.

oneOf.description: No source-patch recommendation.
May be worth considering as a source clarification, but no approval is implied.
Source-patch relevance requires Supervisor or user decision.
Patch approval is recorded in another supervisor/source-patch decision, not in this audit record.

flags.description: Structured attention flags. Empty array means no special handling is currently requested beyond the audit decision itself.

oneOf.description: Strongly supported by source or accepted workflow evidence.
Reasonably supported but may need later review or cross-document confirmation.
Weak or tentative support; use cautiously.
Requires audit, supervisor review, or stronger source evidence before relying on it.
Requires supervisor/user judgment before affected downstream use. May be emitted by any ASI workflow. Handled by Supervisor.
Meaning likely depends on comparison with other documents. Emitted by Extractor, BatchAuditor, TerminologyInferrer, or Indexer. Handled by BatchAuditor or CrossBatchAuditor.
Canonical source may need clearer wording, a missing boundary, compact term, or better source heading. Handled by Supervisor first; SourcePatcher only acts after explicit approval.
May need a better name, ASI alias, boundary phrase, relation name, or source-term proposal. Handled by TerminologyInferrer.
Plausible but weakly grounded in source. Handled by BatchAuditor, CrossBatchAuditor, Indexer, or Supervisor if final routing would depend on it.
Same literal key appears in more than one context and may not mean the same thing. Default handling is split, not merge, unless audit/supervisor decision says otherwise.
Affected output cannot proceed because a required audit, cross-batch, or supervisor decision is unresolved. Handled by Supervisor or the workflow owning the missing decision.
